title: You Cast Level 2 Ban
description: You Cast Level 2 Ban — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Yakov Smearnov

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay the Banned Farmers in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag again and then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Yakov Smearnov

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Slay the Banned Farmers in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag again and then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Time for another sweep with the ban stick! You have made yourself the most qualified Baninator around, so I'm asking you to head back into Upper Ratsputin's Gulag to banish the Banned Farmers back to wherever they came from. This is turning into quite an epic struggle, but at this rate it is only a matter of time before iVan runs out of new recruits for his farm golding empire.

Slay the Banned Farmers located on Level 1, the branch off of Level 1, Level 2, Level 3, the branch off of Level 3, Level 4, and the branch off of Level 4. When you have completed this task return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Nice moves, Dungeon Runner! Is there something you can't ban?! If so, I would like to see it. Let me know when you want to do this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 1
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 1 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 2
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 3
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 3 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 4
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 4 Branch

Level range: 82–100
